# Exchange & Basis
> Baseline 1031 exchange rules and provider comparisons with explicit unknowns. No verified partnerships are asserted.
## State rules
- [Texas](/1031-exchange/texas/): Individual state income tax summary and QI candidates.
- [Florida](/1031-exchange/florida/): Individual tax summary and entity-tax scope limits.
- [California](/1031-exchange/california/): Variable ordinary-income treatment and FTB 3840 reporting.
## Cost segregation
- [Providers and calculator](/cost-segregation/): Assumed excess-basis depreciation scenarios, not eligibility determinations.
- [Methodology](/methodology/): Baseline verification status, model assumptions and sources.
- [Privacy](/privacy/): Intake retention and operator contact.
